finding.expected: Select and validate exactly one recoverable active consumed/uncompleted source-bootstrap-v2 edge while permitting unrelated completed or otherwise fully historical migration edges to remain present and immutable. Continue to fail closed on malformed history, multiple active/conflicting recoverable edges, pending/orphaned supersession evidence, cycles, ambiguous successors, or any bound RUN/completed state on the selected edge. Add deterministic regression coverage with at least one completed historical migration edge plus one recoverable consumed source-bootstrap edge.
finding.issue: Recovery currently requires len(edges) == 1, so any valid completed or otherwise historical migration handoff causes a consumed, uncompleted source-bootstrap v2 edge with no bound RUN to be rejected even when that edge is the only active recoverable authority edge. This makes preserved historical migration evidence an artificial blocker and conflicts with the TASK requirement that old handoff history remain immutable while only conflicting active migration state fails closed.
